how: Claude agent reading of the stored title + abstract, blind to the curated graph, with EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS and CLAIM_SCHEMA

claims.quote: Specific activating missense HRAS variants cause Costello syndrome (CS), a RASopathy with recognizable facial features.

claims.object_mention: enhanced binding to RAF1, RALGDS and PLCE1
claims.quote: HRASGlu62_Arg68dup binding with effectors rapidly accelerated fibrosarcoma (RAF1), RAL guanine nucleotide dissociation stimulator (RALGDS) and phospholipase C1 (PLCE1) was enhanced.
Accordingly, p.Glu62_Arg68dup increased steady-state phosphorylation of MEK1/2 and ERK1/2 downstream of RAF1, whereas AKT phosphorylation downstream of PI3K was not significantly affected.

claims.object_mention: altered interaction with PIK3CA and NF1 GAP
claims.quote: Functional studies showed that the p.Glu62_Arg68dup alteration affects HRAS interaction with effector protein PIK3CA (catalytic subunit of phosphoinositide 3-kinase) and the regulator neurofibromin 1 (NF1) GTPase-activating protein (GAP).
